title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Illinois Tech rituals and recurring events, from trebuchet engineering and Pi Day spirit to campus-wide cultural showcases and ceremonial regalia.

cards.title: Build a Trebuchet, Launch a Pumpkin
cards.subtitle: Illinois Tech’s engineering-heavy fall ritual
cards.notes: Watch student teams send pumpkins across Ed Glancy Field with custom-built trebuchets, or follow the posted link to enter a team.
cards.short_summary: An annual contest turns medieval mechanics into a distinctly Illinois Tech spectacle.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech describes Pumpkin Launch as an annual event in which as many as 10 teams compete to launch pumpkins the farthest using custom-built trebuchets.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 program placed the 19th annual launch at Ed Glancy Field and provided a team-entry link; check the current event schedule before attending.

cards.title: Kick Off Spirit Week with Pi Day
cards.subtitle: Scarlet Hawk spirit starts with 3.14
cards.notes: Look for the Pi Day kickoff, then join the week’s Scarlet Hawk activities with your most unabashedly technical campus spirit.
cards.short_summary: Illinois Tech begins its official Spirit Week by celebrating the mathematical constant pi.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s Spirits and Traditions page says Spirit Week kicks off with Pi Day and celebrates being a Scarlet Hawk.
cards.source_title: Spirits and Traditions | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The tradition page does not provide a current date or participation requirements; consult Student Life announcements for the next schedule.

cards.title: Share a Hometown Through Food
cards.subtitle: Campus traditions meet at one multicultural table
cards.notes: Come ready to sample thoughtfully and ask participants about the hometown traditions represented through each dish and display.
cards.short_summary: A recurring interactive event uses food to share traditions from Illinois Tech’s international community.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech identifies Taste of IIT as a tradition where attendees experience foods from different countries and learn about the university’s international community.
cards.source_title: Spirits and Traditions | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: No current date, menu, price, or attendance policy appears on the cited tradition page; verify event details with Student Life.

cards.title: See MTCC Taken Over After Dark
cards.subtitle: Union Board’s annual all-night-style campus-center event
cards.notes: Plan for games and high-energy attractions throughout MTCC, and confirm the year’s start and finish times before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Once each year, Union Board transforms the campus center with games, food, freebies, and attractions such as bumper cars.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech says Union Board takes over the McCormick Tribune Campus Center once a year for MTCC Late Niite, featuring games, food, freebies, neon lights, and bumper cars.
cards.source_title: Spirits and Traditions | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The official tradition page calls it an annual late-night event but lists no current date or exact hours; verify the active Union Board schedule.

cards.title: Trade Lab Wear for Formalwear
cards.subtitle: Illinois Tech’s dress-up-and-dance tradition
cards.notes: Dress formally enough to enjoy the contrast with an ordinary tech-campus day, then check Student Life for tickets and guest rules.
cards.short_summary: The university’s spring dance gives the technical campus an annual formal-night change of pace.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech lists Spring Formal among its timeless traditions and describes it as an occasion to dress up and dance through the evening.
cards.source_title: Spirits and Traditions | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited page provides no current date, venue, ticket information, dress code, or guest policy; confirm all details before attending.

cards.title: Vote for the Crowd Favorite
cards.subtitle: A Scarlet Hawk talent show with a talon-sized pun
cards.notes: Support student performers across music, dance, poetry, comedy, and more, then cast a vote for the Crowd Favorite prize.
cards.short_summary: The Homecoming talent showcase combines student performances, audience voting, and an Illinois Tech bird pun.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s 2025 Homecoming program invited everyone to its “Talon-t” Show, where students performed and attendees voted for a Crowd Favorite grand prize.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 edition was scheduled at The Bog; use the current Homecoming program to confirm whether and where it returns.

cards.title: Turn Gunsaulus Field into a Carnival
cards.subtitle: Union Board’s annual Homecoming field day
cards.notes: Head to the field for games and giveaways, and bring a payment method if you plan to buy from participating food trucks.
cards.short_summary: Illinois Tech’s Homecoming includes an annual outdoor carnival organized by Union Board and Student Life.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s 2025 Homecoming page describes an annual carnival with food trucks, games, and giveaways, hosted by Union Board and the Office of Student Life.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited edition took place at Gunsaulus Field; attractions and food arrangements may change, so consult the current Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Decorate Pumpkins Beside the Launch
cards.subtitle: Student organizations stage a fall tradition on the field
cards.notes: Pair pumpkin decorating and fall activities with the nearby Pumpkin Launch, using the current program to time both events.
cards.short_summary: Fall Fest gathers student organizations, alumni, students, and families for seasonal activities alongside Pumpkin Launch.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s Homecoming page calls Fall Fest an annual tradition featuring pumpkin decorating and fall-themed activities open to students, alumni, and families.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 edition was at Ed Glancy Field; verify the next date, location, and participation details in the current program.

cards.title: Add a Tree to the Mies Campus Landscape
cards.subtitle: Homecoming grows the campus collection one ceremony at a time
cards.notes: Attend the annual planting and use it as a starting point for noticing native species across the Alphawood Arboretum.
cards.short_summary: An annual Homecoming ceremony adds attention—and a tree—to Illinois Tech’s architecturally significant landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s 2025 Homecoming program invited the community to its annual Alphawood Arboretum tree planting ceremony on Mies Campus.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The cited ceremony was located along 33rd Street between Galvin Library and Hermann Hall; confirm the next planting site and time.

cards.title: Carry Campus History into Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A ceremonial staff made from historic university relics
cards.notes: At a formal university ceremony, watch for the mace and identify the flame, tree, and book retained in Illinois Tech’s seal.
cards.short_summary: Illinois Tech’s ceremonial mace physically joins historic campus relics with symbols of its founding institutions.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech states that its mace is crafted from historic campus relics, depicts the university seal, and follows a tradition introduced at President John L. Anderson’s inauguration.
cards.source_title: About Regalia | Illinois Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The mace appears in formal ceremonial contexts; the cited page does not identify a standing public display or guarantee viewing access.
